headline: Record quarter, raised outlook on surging AI server demand
summary_short: Dell's quarter ended May 1, 2026 delivered record revenue of $43,842M, up 88% y/y, with diluted EPS of $5.24 (+282% y/y) driven by AI-optimized server revenue of $16,132M (+757% y/y); the company raised its full-year revenue outlook to a $167,000M midpoint.
summary_long: Revenue rose 88% y/y to a record $43,842M, led by Infrastructure Solutions Group revenue of $29,009M (+181%) as AI-optimized servers revenue surged 757% to $16,132M on $16.1B of AI server revenue recognized and $24.4B of AI orders booked. Client Solutions Group revenue grew 17% to $14,609M on record commercial-client demand. Operating income more than tripled to $3,656M; net income rose to $3,438M; diluted EPS reached $5.24 (+282% y/y). Operating cash flow was $4,081M against $963M capex; the company returned $2.1B to shareholders. Management raised full-year FY2027 revenue guidance to a $167,000M midpoint and AI-server revenue guidance to ~$60,000M, guiding next-quarter revenue to a $44,500M midpoint and GAAP EPS to $4.48.

drivers.explanation: Management attributed the record quarter to strong in-quarter demand and pace of innovation across PCs, compute and storage, citing $24.4 billion in AI orders booked and $16.1 billion of AI server revenue recognized in the quarter.
Growth was driven by record ISG revenue (+181%), led by AI-optimized servers (+757% to $16,132M) and traditional servers/networking (+92%), plus 17% growth in CSG on record commercial-client demand.
Rose on the same AI-server-led revenue surge combined with operating leverage: ISG operating income rose 206% to $3,055M and CSG operating income rose 79% to $1,170M.
Followed directly from the operating income increase; the release does not separately discuss below-the-line items beyond the income statement's interest and tax lines.
Net income growth plus a 7% reduction in weighted diluted shares outstanding (656M vs 702M) from continued buybacks amplified the per-share gain versus the net income increase alone.
